snippet.title: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🫘 The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! 🫘 Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

Releasing August 11th, 2026 on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux!
